blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Gilas Pilipinas star Justin Brownlee is dealing with health issues involving his heart that have kept him from playing for the national team and Ginebra in the PBA, coach Tim Cone revealed Thursday. In a Senate hearing evaluating Team Philippines’ campaign in the recently concluded Asian Games on Thursday, the veteran mentor explained the reason why Brownlee was unable to join Gilas’ title retention bid in Aichi-Nagoya. READ: Tim Cone rues absence of ‘best players’ after Gilas’ worst Asian Games “Because of a health situation.
